items.exampleEn: The class starts at nine o'clock.
There are twelve months in a year.
I am busy now. Can I call you later?
items.exampleZh: 我現在很忙，可以晚點打給你嗎？

items.exampleEn: January is the first month of the year.
items.exampleZh: 一月是一年的第一個月。

items.exampleEn: There are seven days in a week.
We have a long holiday in May.

items.audioEn: The movie starts at one o'clock. Now it is twelve.
items.audioZh: 電影一點開始，現在是十二點。

items.sentenceEn: This is my first year at this school.
items.sentenceZh: 這是我在這所學校的第一年。

items.stemEn: Today is the ____ day of my new job.
items.stemZh: 今天是我新工作的第一天。

items.passageEn: Today is May 1. It is the first day of my new job. I got up at six o'clock and took the bus at seven. Work starts at eight. Now it is twelve o'clock, and I am having lunch with two new friends. I like my job.
items.passageZh: 今天是五月一日，是我新工作的第一天。我六點起床，七點搭公車。工作八點開始。現在是十二點，我正和兩位新朋友吃午餐。我喜歡我的工作。

questions.questionZh: 說話者現在正在做什麼？

referenceEn: I get up at seven o'clock every day.
Every day, I get up at seven o'clock.
rubricZh: 時間點前用 at（例如 at seven o'clock、at seven）
「起床」可用 get up、wake up 等
每天做的事用現在簡單式；every day 放句首或句尾都可以

referenceEn: This is my first time on a plane.
It is my first time on a plane.
rubricZh: first 放在名詞前（例如 my first time）
「坐飛機」可寫，例如 on a plane、on an airplane 等
